game.subtitle: Build a system. Discover how you think.

runner.subtitle: Move the core. Capture the signal. Dodge the noise.
runner.instructions: Move the core with your mouse or finger. Capture 12 green signals and avoid the red glitches.
runner.wonText: You captured the signal and turned the noise into a living system.
runner.lostText: You were close. Jump back in, chain combos, and keep away from the noise.

launch.title: Launch something that matters
launch.brief: A strong idea must become a desirable, functional product that can find its audience. Connect four disciplines in the order you would use to launch it.
launch.hint: Understand people first. Then build, shape, and amplify.

automate.title: Erase repetitive work
automate.brief: A team loses hours to a manual task. Design a system that detects the pattern, automates it, and becomes effortless to use.
automate.hint: Automation begins with logic, learns the pattern, and ends with experience.

growth.title: Recover a campaign
growth.brief: The product works, but the campaign stopped converting. Build a route that turns scattered data into an experience that drives growth again.
growth.hint: Listen to the market signal, find patterns, and reshape the proposition.

architect.title: SYSTEM ARCHITECT
architect.description: The route is clear, coherent, and actionable. You connected disciplines instead of treating them as silos.

builder.title: SYSTEM BUILDER
builder.description: The system works and its logic is solid. Refine the signal order to multiply its impact.

explorer.title: SIGNAL EXPLORER
explorer.description: You found unexpected connections. Try another sequence: sometimes order changes the entire outcome.
